name: Claude Code Plugins (official marketplace)
what: Anthropic's official plugin marketplace for Claude Code. A plugin bundles skills, subagents, hooks and MCP or LSP servers so you install them in one step. It lists plugins Anthropic maintains (such as commit-commands, code-review, feature-dev and the language-server plugins) alongside plugins from partners and other authors. Claude Code adds this marketplace for you the first time you start an interactive terminal session. The repo is Apache-2.0; each plugin has its own license.
who: Claude Code users who want ready-made workflows or official service integrations without wiring up each skill and MCP server by hand.

setup.text: Start Claude Code in your project with claude, then run /plugin to browse the Discover tab. Or open a plugin's details directly by name and marketplace:

Read the details pane before installing: it lists what the plugin will install (commands, agents, skills, hooks, MCP and LSP servers) and, for this marketplace, a context-cost estimate. Then pick a scope: you (every project), all collaborators on this repository, or you in this repo only.
From your shell instead (user scope by default):
If you see Marketplace "claude-plugins-official" not found (for example on a new machine or if you've only used the VS Code extension), add it, then install again:

Anthropic's own warning applies: plugins can run hooks and MCP servers with your user permissions, and Anthropic doesn't control what third-party plugins include. Check each plugin's homepage or source first. You can also browse the catalog on the web at claude.com/marketplace/plugins.

prompts: Review my open pull request with the code-review plugin.
Which plugins do I have installed, and which of them add MCP servers or hooks?
